name: Holding screen — logo and clock (portrait)
description: A standby screen for when nothing is scheduled: your logo, a big live clock and today's date on a calm background with a soft halo, in your own timezone and language. Keeps a screen looking cared for between campaigns. Portrait 9:16 layout.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A PNG or SVG with a transparent background, light on dark. Shown centred at the top.

params.name: footer
params.label: Footer line
params.help: A short line along the bottom: a place, a floor, a contact. Leave empty for none.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone
params.help: Where the clock and date are for. Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: How the time and date are written, e.g. en-GB, de-DE or fr-CA. Leave empty for the screen's language.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: The halo behind the clock and the small rule.
